info.description: HolidayBase serves public holidays for 250 countries and the working-day arithmetic payroll, logistics, and SLA code actually calls: is-working-day with the reason, working-day counts over a range, and add-working-days in both directions. Every response carries data_vintage with the exact data library versions behind the answer, because holiday law changes and stale data should never be silent. Holiday answers are cross-checked against a second independent library and disagreements are reported in the response. Observed dates appear only when the source library computes them - never invented. Financial-market holidays are a different dataset and are not included or claimed.
